svg.title: Milestones wireframe
svg.text: Retirement can stop income. Life expectancy ends the projection. Both are used by every run.
Retirement 2045 · Debt free 2036 · FI 2042 · Life expectancy 2075
Derived from birth year and target age
Age is 55. Custom criteria and actions ship in #17.
The four defaults are always available: Retirement, Life Expectancy, Financial Independence, and Debt Free.
Markers come from the run result. Retirement at 2045 (age 55) places a marker and stops salary in that year.
Financial Independence completes at 25× spending: the first year net worth crosses the target.
Life Expectancy 2075 (age 85) ends the chart at 2075. Changing it changes the projection horizon.
